CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: The first color used for the audio elements when the "elements use scheme" toggle is off
CONTROLS.NAME: elements_color1

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Select the color palette that the audio elements and feedback use
CONTROLS.NAME: color_select

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Moves through the selected palette, moving the starting position of selected scheme.
CONTROLS.NAME: color_offset

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Changes the hue of the selected color palette. Use this knob to find the exact color combo you need
CONTROLS.NAME: hue_offset

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: When enabled, this toggle will make the elements use the selected palette. When disabled, it will use the custom elements color controls
CONTROLS.NAME: elements_use_scheme

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: The second color used for the audio elements when the "elements use scheme" toggle is off
CONTROLS.NAME: elements_color2

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Adjusts the frequency of the color palette, higher values create more color repetition
CONTROLS.NAME: palette_mod

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Sets the method for how the audio elements are colored
CONTROLS.NAME: coloring_style

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Skews the scene colors towards bright primary colors. Use with the lighting knob for extra effect
CONTROLS.NAME: neon_lighting

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Creates a traveling vignette that brightens the scene and tampers the colors
CONTROLS.NAME: lighting

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Controls the over all level of feedback the elements and media produce
CONTROLS.NAME: master_feedback

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Changes the behavior of the feedback. Each selection behaves differently with the "master feedback" slider and "unfurl feedback" toggle
CONTROLS.NAME: feedback_style

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Fills empty space with waves of feedback. This effect is heavily affected by the "master feedback" slider
CONTROLS.NAME: unfurl_feedback

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Sets the audio elements grid size from 3 to 4, causing smaller elements and an overall noisier scene
CONTROLS.NAME: noisy_grid

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Jump the position of all elements on screen
CONTROLS.NAME: scramble_elements

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Adjusts the threshold for the number of elements on each grid level
CONTROLS.NAME: element_count

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Toggles the depth of field and parallax effect
CONTROLS.NAME: use_parallax

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Slide the elements across the vertical and horizontal axis
CONTROLS.NAME: slide_rows

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Drift the camera based on the velocity of this control change
CONTROLS.NAME: drift

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Automatically drifts the camera in random directions in time with the beat
CONTROLS.NAME: cam_auto_pilot

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Adjusts how intensely the auto pilot moves on beat. Requires the “cam auto pilot” toggle to be enabled
CONTROLS.NAME: auto_pilot_sensitivity

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Moves the camera in and out of the grid. use the “set layer” bangs to quickly set a desired layer with the elements in focus
CONTROLS.NAME: depth

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Quickly set the depth control to the bottom layer
CONTROLS.NAME: set_bottom_layer

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Quickly set the depth control to the middle layer
CONTROLS.NAME: set_middle_layer

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Quickly set the depth control to the top layer
CONTROLS.NAME: set_top_layer

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: randomly moves the depth slider in time to the beat
CONTROLS.NAME: depth_auto_pilot

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Distort each grid layer with a barrel distortion that bounces to the bass
CONTROLS.NAME: distortion_pulse

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Masks out the scene with circuit like pulses that radiate from the center
CONTROLS.NAME: circuits

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Sets the scene to use the media color instead of the color palette
CONTROLS.NAME: use_media_col

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Multiplies the media with the feedback layer, masking out the feedback
CONTROLS.NAME: multiply_media

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Adjusts the amount that user media is mixed into the reactive elements. Use this slider to fine tune how much the media shows through
CONTROLS.NAME: media_mix
